message:
CAP_AM meets Monday/Wednesday, 8:00–9:15 a.m.; CAP_ALT meets Tuesday/Thursday, 8:00–9:15 a.m. Either schedule totals 12 credits, within your required 12–16 credits, and fulfills CAP4000. You have completed the prerequisite, CS3000.

CAP_ALT has one available seat, conflicts with neither KEEP_A nor KEEP_B, and ends before your Tuesday/Thursday work hours (noon–5 p.m.). It meets all hard requirements, but—like CAP_AM—does not satisfy your afternoon-class preference.

Your approved KEEP_A, KEEP_B, and CAP_AM schedule remains unchanged.
